data.title: Hop Back on the Number Line
data.description: Learn to subtract by taking two backward jumps on the number line to find mystery numbers.

challenges.instruction: Can you find a secret number hiding strictly between 3 and 6 on the number line?
challenges.hint: Start at 3 and count up, or start at 6 and count down, to see what numbers live in the middle.

challenges.instruction: Look at the number line! Can you find a secret number that is strictly between 1 and 4?
challenges.hint: Start at 1 and count forward, or start at 4 and count backward, to see which numbers live in the middle.

challenges.instruction: Can you find a secret number that hides right between 2 and 6 on the number line?
challenges.hint: Start at 2 and count up, or start at 6 and count down, to see which numbers are in the middle.

challenges.instruction: Look at the number line and find a mystery number that is strictly between 2 and 5! Tap or type the number that lives in that space.
challenges.hint: Think about the numbers that come right after 2 and right before 5.
